text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no way to execute commands here, so I found each bug by reading the code against the tests.

- **`fees.py`:** the late fee now multiplies days by the daily rate (`days_late * DAILY_FEE`). It was adding them.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5. It was 3.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns exactly the last `n` events. It was returning `n + 1`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` now includes the missing `Emma` book (Austen, 1815, 1 copy). The Austen details are my choice, because the factory docstring only gives the title.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an int. It was leaving it as a string.
- **`search.py`:** it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`. The old module, `catalog.nonexistent`, doesn't exist.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm the suite passes.
